paragraphs.source_en: Ever since Lady Yodo declared that she and her son would take their own lives, a strange melancholy had pervaded Osaka Castle, and no one dared speak freely. “How pitiful. If they truly mean to do that, how could we go on living?” From the Seven Captains down to the ladies-in-waiting and tea attendants, everyone said the same thing.

paragraphs.source_en: What worried Urakusai most, however, was that the melancholy within the castle might spill beyond its walls and again unsettle the common people, who had only just grown calm. Should any lawless men conceive evil designs, the Kyoto deputy and the Sakai magistrate would surely send troops to intervene. That could furnish both a pretext and an opportunity, and no one knew how great a disturbance might follow. Urakusai therefore implored Kōdai-in to keep these dangers firmly in mind and devote greater care to Hideyori.
